fields.Name: Manage Form Defaults
fields.Description: Lets a user publish a full custom entity form or a form panel to a role or to everyone, and change or remove one that is. Without it a user manages only their own personal forms and panels. Enforced on every write path by the server-side subclasses of MJ: Entity Form Overrides and MJ: Entity Form Contributions. It does not let a holder edit or remove another user's personal items.
